description: Amendments to planning permission dated 28 March 2012 (RN:11/05626/FULL) for Variation of Condition 91 of planning permission dated 12 November 2009 (APP/X5990/A/09/2101893) for redevelopment of site to provide new buildings of two basements, lower ground, ground and nine upper floors to northern part of site (fronting Strand), and two basements, ground and part 10/part  14/part 12 upper floors to southern part of site (fronting Temple Place) to provide offices (Class B1); 151 residential dwellings (Class C3); 98-bed hotel and 18 serviced suites (Class C1); and/or retail, financial and professional services, restaurant, café, bar, and hot food take away uses (Class A1/A2/A3/A4/A5) at ground floor level; car parking for 107 cars; servicing area; and new access, public courtyard, landscaping, engineering and other associated works, namely amendments to vehicle access arrangements from Arundel Street, to the internal cores at ground level, to the internal servicing and car parking layout at basement levels and creation of an additional third basement level. Namely, removal of condition 87 which required Code for Sustainable Homes certification.
